scientific_question: Do CA1 pyramidal neurons that sit near reactive astrocytes show donor-level soma area shifts that add degenerative signal beyond the current CA1 composition and niche-coverage panel?
approach: Within CA1, use cell labels to identify Pyramidal Neuron and Reactive Astrocyte cells. Build a nearest-neighbor search on CA1 reactive astrocyte centroids, select CA1 pyramidal neurons whose centroid lies within radius r of any reactive astrocyte centroid, compute each selected pyramidal neuron's contour area with a centered-contour shoelace calculation, then summarize the donor by the median log1p(area_px2) across selected cells. This yields a simple donor-level morphology biomarker anchored to the already-supported CA1 reactive-astrocyte niche.

variations.name: median_log_area_60px
variations.description: Baseline: median log1p contour area of CA1 pyramidal neurons within 60 px of any CA1 reactive astrocyte centroid.

variations.name: median_log_area_80px
variations.description: Local radius sweep: same biomarker but using an 80 px reactive-astrocyte proximity gate.

notes: Assign cells to CA1 using CustomAnnotations polygons after dividing annotation coordinates by 16. Use centroids from SegmentationNode for distance queries and contours from SegmentationNode for area; center each contour before polygon area calculation to avoid float32 cancellation. Keep the feature in raw px^2 space with log1p transform; SVS MPP conversion is optional and not required for comparability here. Handle donors with very low selected-cell counts gracefully by returning NaN rather than forcing a value.
rationale: Rounds 1-4 established a strong CA1 pyramidal/reactive-astrocyte axis, but the tiny gain from coverage and the discard of encirclement suggest that further adjacency topology on the same cells is becoming redundant. The next clean test is to keep the same biological niche and switch modality from composition/spatial arrangement to morphology: if reactive-astrocyte-proximal pyramidal neurons are selectively atrophic or enlarged in worse-memory donors, this could add nonredundant signal or replace the weaker global pyramidal fraction with a more disease-proximal readout.
